title: JUNO: Optimizing High-Dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbour Search with Sparsity-Aware Algorithm and Ray-Tracing Core Mapping
problem: Product quantization-based ANN search methods perform unnecessary pairwise distance calculations and accumulations, limiting search throughput. High-dimensional vector search systems struggle with datasets containing millions of search points.
motivation: Approximate nearest neighbor search is fundamental to modern recommendation systems and vector databases, requiring efficient and high-throughput execution for practical deployment.
method: JUNO adopts a sparsity-aware and locality-aware search algorithm to eliminate redundant distance computations. The system maps this algorithm to GPU hardware, leveraging ray tracing cores for accelerated execution alongside pipelined tensor core operations to maximize throughput and efficiency.
key_novelty: Repurposing GPU ray tracing cores for sparsity-aware approximate nearest neighbor search acceleration, enabling efficient computation beyond traditional graphics rendering.
contributions: Characterization of inefficiencies in product quantization-based ANN methods identifying unnecessary computations
Sparsity-aware and locality-aware algorithm design for ANN search
Efficient hardware mapping utilizing ray tracing cores in modern GPUs with pipelined tensor core execution
2.2×-8.5× throughput improvements on datasets from 1 to 100 million search points

metrics.speedup: 2.2×-8.5× throughput improvement; 2.6× from algorithmic enhancements alone

primary_theme: GPU-accelerated ANN search using sparsity-aware algorithms and ray-tracing core mapping
